item.title: San Diego sailors advised by to take extra precautions in public
item.description: Navy sailors in the San Diego area are reportedly being advised to take extra precautions in public, such as changing out of uniform when leaving base, due to heightened military activity.

item.title: Box truck carrying solar panels catches fire on I-15 in San Diego
item.description: A box truck carrying a shipment of solar panels caught fire on southbound Interstate 15 in-between Normal Heights and Kensington on Friday morning, causing heavy congestion and blocking the far right lane.

item.title: Rady Children's Health co-president and CEO steps down
item.description: The CEO and co-president of Rady Children's Health is stepping down, the health care system announced on Thursday.

item.title: Juvenile faces felony charges for allegedly carrying concealed, loaded ghost gun
item.description: A juvenile was arrested in San Marcos on Friday after deputies allegedly found an unserialized, loaded pistol concealed in their waistband during a traffic stop.

item.title: Rooftop Cinema Club unveils fresh spring lineup of films, honors late '90s heartthrob
item.description: The Rooftop Cinema Club in San Diego has moved to a new location atop the Porto Vista Hotel in Little Italy and is offering a lineup of over 100 movies for March and April, including cult classics, films celebrating women, and films adapted from classic novels.

item.title: Supervisor Jim Desmond launches campaign for California's 48th District
item.description: SAN DIEGO (FOX 5/KUSI) -- San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond on Friday announced his campaign for Congress in California's 48th Congressional District. The U.S. Navy veteran and Republican made the announcement following Congressman Darrell Issa's retirement on Friday. Representative Issa is endorsing Jim Desmond's campaign for Congress. item.title: Sleep expert offers tips on adjusting to daylight saving time
item.description: Experts suggest getting enough sleep and making small changes, such as getting sunlight in the morning and reducing screentime before bed, to help adjust to the loss of an hour of sleep due to daylight saving time.

item.title: Main Gate at Camp Pendleton reopens after hours-long closure, bases on high alert
item.description: Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton's main gate has been closed until further notice, and motorists are being advised to use alternative routes and check the base's website for updates.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of luring and inappropriately touching girl, 12, in San Diego
item.description: San Diego police arrested a man suspected of kidnapping and making inappropriate physical contact with a young girl who was walking home from school in the Bay Terraces neighborhood.

item.title: Rep. Darrell Issa drops out of congressional race
item.description: Darrell Issa has ended his congressional campaign for California District 48 and endorsed San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond to replace him.
